samples.summary: verify:consumer builds only the shell, never `dist/plugin` — the fixture consumer now resolves the plugin through `exports` to `dist/plugin/index.js`, so a clean checkout fails and a dirty one tests stale bytes
samples.evidence: The delta rewrites this docblock to claim "the build is its own `design-editor:build` lane besides, so a broken build fails before this script is reached". But no lane runs `verify:consumer` at all (grep: it exists only as a package script and in docs), so CI never guarantees anything for this script's inputs. `buildShellIfMissing()` (line 197-206) rebuilds ONLY `dist/shell/index.html` via `vite build --config ./vite.shell.config.ts`; it never runs `build:plugin` (`tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`). Since #966, `packages/design-editor/fixtures/consumer/vite.config.ts:17` imports `@wafflebase/design-editor` BY NAME, and package.json:9 maps `.` to `./dist/plugin/index.js`. `dist/` is gitignored, so on a clean checkout `boot()` dies with `Cannot find module .../dist/plugin/index.js` — exactly the failure class the new `design-editor:build` lane was added to prevent elsewhere. Worse, when a stale `dist/plugin` exists, the staleness comparison at line 190-199 only compares src mtimes against the SHELL bundle, so an edit under `src/plugin/**` leaves the gate exercising the previously compiled plugin — the "gate that can pass on stale bytes" hazard the same comment warns about.

samples.summary: `pnpm design` rebuilds only when `src/shell` is newer than the shell bundle, so an edit under `src/plugin/**` silently runs against a stale compiled plugin (or a missing one is only caught by luck)
samples.evidence: `const shellStale = !existsSync(SHELL_DIST) || newestMtime(SHELL_SRC) > statSync(SHELL_DIST).mtimeMs;` with `SHELL_SRC = packages/design-editor/src/shell` (line 32) and `SHELL_DIST = dist/shell/index.html` (line 31). Since the exports map now names `dist/plugin/index.js`, `packages/design-sandbox/vite.config.ts` loads the COMPILED plugin, whose sources are `src/plugin/**`, `src/base.ts`, `src/tokens/adapter.ts`, `src/types.ts` (tsconfig.build.json:37) — none of which are in the staleness window. A developer editing the plugin then runs `pnpm design` and sees the old behaviour with no warning. verdict.reason: Every element of the finding checks out. verify-scenes.mjs:66-87 runs only the shell build (`vite build --config ./vite.shell.config.ts`, i.e. `build:shell`), verify-scenes.mjs:204-219 only `pnpm --filter @wafflebase/core build`, and main() (verify-scenes.mjs:221-223) calls just those two before boot(). The dev server it boots loads packages/design-sandbox/vite.config.ts, which imports `@wafflebase/design-editor` (vite.config.ts:49) with no alias override; that package's exports["."] resolves to ./dist/plugin/index.js (packages/design-editor/package.json:6-10), produced only by the separate `build:plugin` tsc step (package.json:20). `dist/` is absent from the tree/gitignored, and the repo's own lane config confirms the failure mode: scripts/verify-self.mjs:303-329 and :452-464 add a dedicated design-editor:build lane precisely because an unbuilt checkout yields `Cannot find module …/dist/plugin/index.js`. boot() spawns `pnpm exec vite` (verify-scenes.mjs:90-93), bypassing the design-sandbox `predev` hook (packages/design-sandbox/package.json:10) that would have built the plugin. Worse, the staleness walk covers packages/design-editor/src including src/plugin, so a plugin-source change triggers a shell-only rebuild that refreshes dist/shell/index.html's mtime and hides the stale plugin dist on later runs — the gate then validates scenes against out-of-date plugin code. No guard makes this unreachable; it is a real correctness/reliability defect in this lens's lane.

finding.summary: Preview subset link can shrink a family that the app shell already loaded in full (Inter / Fraunces / JetBrains Mono from index.html)
finding.evidence: `ensurePreviewFontLink` only refuses to inject a subset when (a) the catalog entry is `eager` (i.e. in `buildGoogleFontsHref`'s bootstrap link) or (b) a wafflebase-injected full link exists (`findFontLink`, line 226). It knows nothing about the *app-shell* stylesheet in `packages/frontend/index.html:12`, which loads `Fraunces`, `Inter` and `JetBrains Mono` in full. All three are curated-catalog entries with no `eager: true` (`font-catalog.data.ts:30`, `:64`, `:66`), so merely scrolling the font dropdown/dialog past the "Inter" row appends `css2?family=Inter:wght@400&text=Inter&display=swap` to `document.head` — declared *after* index.html's link, with no `unicode-range`, so by the author's own cascade reasoning (see the docstring at lines 206-210, which raises exactly this hazard for the full-link case) it wins font matching for weight 400 and the face then lacks every glyph outside "Inter". Inter is the app/token body font (`packages/core/scripts/build-css.ts:98` → `--font-body`) and the default Slides theme font (`packages/slides/src/themes/default-light.ts:20`), so the blast radius is app-wide UI text and Slides canvas text falling back to a system face for the rest of the session. The previous code path (`ensureFontLink`) requested the whole family and could not lose glyphs.

verdict.reason: Verified independently. `ensurePreviewFontLink` (packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/font-catalog.ts:222-227) skips injection only for SSR, non-webFont, `entry.eager`, an existing `data-wafflebase-font` link, or an existing preview link. `findFontLink` (:123-131) queries only `link[data-wafflebase-font]`, and `buildGoogleFontsHref` (:113) covers only `eager` families — so nothing in the guard set knows about the app-shell stylesheet at packages/frontend/index.html:12, which loads Fraunces, Inter and JetBrains Mono in full with no marker attribute. All three are curated entries without `eager` (font-catalog.data.ts:30, :64, :66) and carry `weights: "400;700"`, so `previewWeight` (:184-187) requests exactly wght@400 — the same face the shell already serves. The path is reachable with no filter: font-family-picker.tsx:71 groups the entire FONT_CATALOG, :250-251 stamps `data-font-row` on every row, and the IntersectionObserver at :112-139 calls `ensurePreviewFontLink` for any row scrolled into view (more-fonts-dialog.tsx:138-165 likewise). The `&text=` payload has no `unicode-range`, so this later-declared @font-face shadows the shell's full Inter 400 — the precise hazard the function's own docstring (:206-210) claims to guard. Inter is the app body font (packages/core/scripts/build-css.ts:98 -> packages/core/src/tokens/typography.ts:5) and the default Slides theme font (packages/slides/src/themes/default-light.ts:20), so impact is app-wide UI and Slides canvas text. The one inaccuracy in the finding (Inter literal lives in typography.ts, not build-css.ts) does not affect the substance. No guard or caller makes this unreachable.
